profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer. Secretly, I am actually 3 dogs in a trenchcoat.

I like finance, communication, and transportation. Logistics underpin everything.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (63)
positions.description: My MS Office code is deployed around the world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.locationName: Greenwood Village, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Build data pipelines processing GBs of usage data across geos. Reduce memory usage of internal data framework to improve throughput and robustness.
Parallelize Python scripts. Improve automated executive reports. Build data model and new analysis workflows for attached support team.
Resolve workflow and process issues by proposing and refining working agreements for product area.
Mentor junior engineers and data analysts. Pairing.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Individual contributor using Spring on Kotlin while defining interdepartmental process improvements.
Built greenfield APIs and added security and features to credit application microservices and integrations.
Collaborated on scrum and agile rituals, integrating big-tech ideals into project management.
Improved peer technical designs by innovating documentation and as an architecture review panelist.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Framework · Kotlin

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Contributed Java extension to commons for object relational mapper resolving noop vs delete intent.
Resolved async issues using Redux library and contributed features using recent browser APIs.
Mentored junior and peer engineers on productivity, communications, and technical skills.
Agile processes. Systems oriented. Goal-driven. Secretly, I am three dogs in a trenchcoat.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Tech Lead of 10-engineer team starting 2018 Q4 building an Angular 2 (TypeScript) app with 6-month roadmap. Responsible for architecture and design, sprint planning, code health, and launch reviews.
Built Java servers on App Engine, Borg. Hosted data variously on Spanner, CloudSQL, and Hibernate ORM. Served APIs via Google-internal standards.
First across company to use internal streaming techology on Cloud Dataflow for pipeline of complex real-world data. Contributed code to the host project to fix several issues and provide additional features.
Built asynchronous messaging on Cloud Pub/Sub for realtime data propagation between peer systems.
Configured monitoring and dashboards on internal tools for servers, APIs, pipelines, and integrations.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Work with MVC paradigm on a multi-site development team in the Symfony2 framework.
Study and apply knowledge of version control and unit testing tools to drive high-speed development.
Exposed to development from front-end via JQuery to database manipulation via the Doctrine ORM.

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Educate new students on CS funamentals, Python, and Java, encouraging strong code design.
Guide students toward achieving personal and department goals, inspiring confidence and interest.

volunteerExperiences.role: Eagle Scout and Senior Patrol Leader

projects.title: Senior Development Technical Manager
projects.description:
Assist Project Manager in management of team, focusing on team resources and education to enable team.
Guide and integrate project design and final release, applying software development principles and facililtating ease of development and release.
Apply general programming knowledge to code base, utilising development skills to ensure client satisfaction.
